decisions.reason: The accepted LCSC part C94598 is specifically the passive-buzzer candidate; it does not change the LED array's independently selected LCSC part C5149201.
Accepting a passive-buzzer part does not alter the main-board addressable LED model, supply voltage, power control, or data-level handling.
The buzzer part selection contains no decision about an ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The source accepts a buzzer component and does not add, remove, or modify any main-board connector.
The passive-buzzer part acceptance does not change the requirement for main-board decoupling capacitors.
The source decision concerns only the buzzer component and does not alter panel controls, inputs, wiring, or connector coverage.
Selecting the passive buzzer does not change the power-source OR-ing method, sources, or source-selection behavior.
The buzzer part acceptance does not necessarily change the monitored rails, monitor IC, channel allocation, or stated current-coverage semantics.
The source does not state that the accepted buzzer is part of the switched 3.3V load or modify that circuit's topology or transistor pair.
Accepting a buzzer part does not resolve or change the standalone USB power source, capacity requirement, powered scope, or existing LDO ambiguity.
The passive-buzzer selection is unrelated to the I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, and population policy.
The accepted buzzer component does not change the battery-charge status indicator, GPIO, connector, or resistor configuration.
